paper.observed: as in sa03, Paged.js 0.4.3 on Chromium 141 keeps the portrait sheet; the landscape content is clipped at the right of the PDF page

pages.basis: plain Paged.js measurement (9 pages); forced breaks at h2.newpage and the two named-page switches; the ledger table and prose may shift by one page

expectedExit.derivation: Error finding on #members-roll under the structural sum (exit 1). Under WP-F3 round 2 the split table and the landscape budget rows are declined as env/invalid-measurement, and a decline of the error rule leaves its coverage below 1 (exit 4, which outranks findings). Tables cross page boundaries (#tbl-ledger, #members-roll) and a landscape page is drawn on a portrait sheet, so exit 3 render-unstable is admitted as 'declined as unmeasurable' (docs/limitations.md); the plain probe saw no table residue.

byCode.3: render-unstable (table residue or landscape PDF divergence)
byCode.4: insufficient-coverage: layout/unbreakable-block-too-tall declines under WP-F3 round 2

expectedExit.environmentNote: Exit 4 with exitReason evidence/required-page-binding-incomplete is an environment failure (evidence binding not supported by the renderer), not an outcome of these documents; run the gate where the live path binds evidence (CI).

fontDependence: Only generic families (serif, sans-serif, monospace) are used. Line breaks, paragraph heights and therefore the position of flowing text depend on the fonts the renderer resolves; every construction fact below is built from explicit heights, fixed line pitches, forced breaks or SVG coordinates so that it does not depend on them, and every font-dependent outcome is listed as allowed.

mustNotFire.why: break-inside: avoid blocks that are shorter than the page content box (912.0 px) and are laid out in one piece
table rows carry break-inside: avoid; every row is a single short line of cells, far below the 912 portrait / 700.8 landscape px content box

allowed.why: a register table with break-inside: avoid that is 2.56 content boxes tall. Under the structural sum over three or more fragments (0.6.0, with flow membership from WP-F1) it is reported, exit 1. WP-F3 round 2 (G-03/G-81; README 'Release semantics', tracing) replaces the structural sum over three or more fragments with a lower bound from the content extent of each fragment (text lines and replaced content), and declines with env/invalid-measurement, charged to the rule's coverage floor of 1, a split block whose snapshot records a flow hazard (out-of-flow, offset, sticky, transformed, float, multicol, flex-or-grid, table-columns, vertical-writing, negative-margin, overflowing-content), a split block whose bound stays at or below the page (inconclusive), and an unsplit block that is transformed or reaches past the sheet; this table has six columns, so its rows carry the hazard table-columns and the block is declined, exit 4. Which of the two the admitting release documents was not settled when this was written, so the finding is allowed rather than required (erratum E30); the exit set admits both.
allowed.construction: header row + 110 body rows of fixed 20 px cells (21 px per row with the collapsed border) = 2331 px measured against 912 px (Letter, 0.75 in): pushed to a fresh page and split 903 + 903 + 525 px

expectedDeclines.why: split table with six columns (flow hazard table-columns)
